user.title: Video & TV SideView (Legacy API)
user.description:
Control older Sony TVs, Blu-ray players, and home theatre systems that work with the Video & TV SideView app.

Enter the device IP. It must be powered on and on the same subnet as Home Assistant. Leave ports at defaults unless your model needs different ones.

MAC is optional at this step — used for Wake-on-LAN (power on from standby). Leave blank to auto-detect after pairing, or enter AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

This does not replace official Sony Bravia, PlayStation, or Songpal integrations.

data.name: Name
data.mac: MAC address (optional, for power on / WOL)

pin.title: Enter PIN
pin.description: A PIN should now be displayed on {host}. Enter it below. If nothing appears, enable Media Remote Device Registration on the device, power-cycle, and try again.

mac.title: MAC address (Wake-on-LAN)
mac.description:
Device at {host}: MAC {hint}.

Power-on from standby needs a MAC for magic packets. Enter it now or leave blank (turn-on may not work until set under Configure).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check IP, power, same subnet, ports, and that Media Remote registration is enabled on the device.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid PIN. Check the code on the device and try again.

init.title: SideView options
init.description: Update MAC (for power on) and ports without re-pairing.
